publicLegalConcepts.name: Consent
publicLegalConcepts.description: A lawful search may sometimes be conducted with valid permission from a person authorized to give it. Permission may be limited or withdrawn.

publicLegalConcepts.name: Search Authority
publicLegalConcepts.description: Private areas generally require a lawful basis before they may be searched.

publicLegalConcepts.name: Warrant Scope
publicLegalConcepts.description: A warrant authorizes only the places and categories described by its approved scope.

publicLegalConcepts.name: Reasonable Suspicion
publicLegalConcepts.description: Temporary detention requires specific, articulable investigative support.

publicLegalConcepts.name: Probable Cause
publicLegalConcepts.description: An arrest or warrant requires stronger factual support than mere suspicion.

publicLegalConcepts.name: Procedural Consequences
publicLegalConcepts.description: Improper investigative actions may weaken evidence, damage cooperation, or affect later prosecutorial decisions.
